column1: How can I apply for admission?
column2: You can apply by completing the admission application form and submitting the required documents.

column1: What documents are required for admission?
column2: Common documents include academic marksheets, identity proof, photographs and applicable certificates. Confirm the official list with the admission office.

Eligible students may apply for scholarships according to government and college schemes.

column1: What are the college office hours?
column2: Office hours vary by department. Please contact the college office to confirm the current timings.

column1: How can I contact the college?
column2: You can contact the college through its official website or visit the administrative office.

column1: Where can I get my admission receipt?
column2: Please contact the accounts or admission office to request a copy of your receipt.

column1: Can I change my course after admission?
column2: Course changes depend on college rules, seat availability and applicable university regulations. Contact the admission office.
